besluite.fout: The time span 'in die tydperk van 1220 tot 1300' wedged between 'was' and its complement reads wordy and stiff.
besluite.rede: Fronting 'Van 1220 tot 1300' is the natural Afrikaans order, shorter for a Grade 6 reader, and keeps the dates, 'die dorp', 'hoofstad' and the protected 'koninkryk' unchanged; it is not a re-make of the earlier rejected 'bestaan' sentence, which no longer exists.

besluite.fout: 'dat mense nie op dieselfde manier begrawe is nie' can be read as saying no one was buried the same way as anyone else.
besluite.rede: 'nie almal ... nie' states the intended contrast between groups plainly, echoes the block heading 'Nie almal het dieselfde geleef nie', and adds no name, fact or reason.
